title: Twenty Days Later: A Pre-Registered Test of History-Based Forecasts of Brand Mentions in Gemini Answers
abstract: arXiv:2610.19608v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Counts of which brands a large language model names are useful only if they hold long enough to act on. We test this with a pre-registered replication. The same 162 requests (54 questions in English, Estonian and Finnish about three software categories, four of twelve candidate brands per question, three repeats) were sent to gemini-3.1-pro-preview in three waves within about ten hours on 22 and 23 September 2026, and again on 13 October 2026, 20.3 days after the third wave, with identical request bodies. The plan and its decision rule were frozen, hashed and registered on OSF before the first call. The outcome is a lexical mention label per answer and brand, 648 per wave. The primary forecast, each brand-and-question cell's mention rate over the nine earlier answers, scored Brier 0.0281 and log loss 0.126, against Brier 0.0259 for the six-answer forecast of the 8-hour wave and a registered ceiling of 0.0559. translated_title: 二十天后：对Gemini回答中基于历史的品牌提及预测的预注册检验
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.19608v1 公告类型：交叉（cross）摘要：大型语言模型提及哪些品牌的计数，只有在其能维持足够长时间以供采取行动时才有用。我们通过一项预注册的重复实验来检验这一点。相同的162个请求（54个问题，涉及三个软件类别，分别以英语、爱沙尼亚语和芬兰语提出，每个问题包含12个候选品牌中的4个，重复三次）于2026年9月22日至23日在约十小时内分三波发送给gemini-3.1-pro-preview，并于2026年10月13日（即第三波之后20.3天）以完全相同的请求体再次发送。实验计划及其决策规则在首次调用之前被冻结、哈希并注册在OSF上。结果指标是每个答案与品牌的词汇提及标签，每波648个。主要预测——每个品牌-问题单元格在之前九个答案中的提及率——取得了Brier得分0.0281和对数损失0.126的成绩，相比之下，8小时波次的六答案预测Brier得分为0.0259，注册的上限为0.0559。它优于品牌历史基线（0.1……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过预注册的重复实验证明，基于历史数据对Gemini回答中品牌提及率的预测在约20天后依然准确（Brier得分0.0281，接近8小时短期预测水平且优于品牌历史基线），表明大语言模型的品牌提及计数具有足够的时间稳定性，可供实际决策使用。
en_tdlr: A pre-registered replication shows that history-based forecasts of brand mentions in Gemini answers remain accurate 20 days later (Brier 0.0281, nearly matching the 8-hour forecast and beating brand-history baselines), demonstrating that LLM brand mention counts are temporally stable enough to act on.
